capabilities.name: v4.title.insert
capabilities.description: Insert an installed native title at exact rational start/duration on a positive connected lane; return persistent clip_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.
Requires an existing primary storyline and an unoccupied lane interval; lane 0 insert/ripple is not supported.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.

capabilities.name: v4.title.set_text

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.

capabilities.name: v4.title.set_style
capabilities.description: Patch non-overlapping UTF-16 style spans on one native field, and optionally set clip pixel position. Composed characters cannot be split.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.
At least one span or position is required. Alignment is paragraph-scoped by AppKit; position applies to the clip at source_start, not to individual glyphs.
Optional Motion persistence/refresh selectors require live save/reopen/render verification.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.

capabilities.name: v4.transition.set
capabilities.description: Set a centered transition at an explicit pair of adjacent primary clip IDs. fail rejects insufficient handles; shorten reduces transition duration; freeze requests native frozen-edge overlap.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.
Supports unretimed FFAnchoredMediaComponent cuts only; requires even frame duration. Native operation argument semantics, replacement and mode-2 frozen edge rendering still need live verification.
No preference writes, selection changes or legacy transitions.apply calls. Project duration must match readback.
Source sample duration must exactly match the active sequence frame duration; rate-conformed and retimed cases fail closed.

capabilities.name: v4.transition.remove
capabilities.description: Remove only the transition at the explicit cut while preserving project duration; optionally guard its persistent transition_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.
The native time-preserving removal selector ABI is verified; its object/cut-time argument semantics require live verification.

capabilities.name: v4.generator.insert
capabilities.description: Insert an installed native generator at exact lane/start/duration; return persistent clip_id for parameter inspection without allocating an unused runtime handle.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: FCP 12.4 build 454072 selectors are statically checked; no live FCP execution in this workstream.
revision_before/after are null until the operation core supplies them. Native state must be reconciled after applied=null.
Parameter tree traversal and editing belong to the params workstream v4.object.inspect. parameter_inspection is a handoff hint, not a call performed by insert.
Requires an existing primary storyline and an unoccupied positive connected lane; lane 0 is unsupported.
